paragraphs.text: Muggtoth was a zombie cyclops from Dominaria that was killed by Ugin .

Muggtoth was a cyclops with the ability to foresee his potential death. After dying once and being raised from the dead, he avoided all possible deaths until a slow, painful, battle with Viperwick pollen poisoning. While suffering, he encountered Vissk , who had seen Muggtoth in a vision of the future. He had his apprentice Pinaphet give him an antidote which relieved some pain. However, soon after, a time rift opened revealing Ugin , who killed Muggtoth and Vissk with ghostfire . As he burned into nothing, Muggtoth was at peace, thankful for the end to come.
